title: 새 직장 첫날: 동료에게 자기소개하기
objective: Introduce yourself to a new coworker and ask polite questions with -습니까/-ㅂ니까.
summary: A first-day office conversation: introduce yourself and ask polite questions with -습니까/-ㅂ니까.
setting: It is Mark's first morning at a company in Seoul. A coworker, Kim Sujin, comes to his desk. To ask a question in this style, use -ㅂ니까 after a vowel (가다 → 갑니까?) and -습니까 after a consonant (먹다 → 먹습니까?).

task.title: Introduce yourself and ask
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, change, or write the right Korean.

words.meaning: Nice to meet you (said politely the very first time you meet)
words.exampleMeaning: Nice to meet you. I'm Lee Minho.
What time do you eat lunch?

dialogue.meaning: Hello. Is today your first day here?
Yes. Nice to meet you. I'm Mark Johnson.
Nice to meet you. I'm Kim Sujin. I work on the marketing team.
I work on the sales team. I'm from the U.S.
Oh, really? Where did you learn Korean?
I learned it at university. I'm not very good yet.
Not at all. You speak Korean well.

dialogue.korean: 감사합니다. 수진 씨, 점심은 보통 어디에서 먹습니까?
dialogue.meaning: Thank you. Sujin, where do you usually eat lunch?

dialogue.korean: 회사 식당에서 먹습니다. 오늘 같이 먹어요.
dialogue.meaning: I eat at the company cafeteria. Let's eat together today.

exercises: Choose the right form. ① is a question, ② is an answer: ① 주말에 보통 무엇을 (합니까 / 합니다)? ② 저는 주말에 보통 영화를 (봅니까 / 봅니다).
Change each sentence into a polite -ㅂ니까/-습니까 question: ① 사무실이 넓다 ② 지금 바쁘다 ③ 매일 운동하다
Fill in each blank with a word from the word list (use the -ㅂ니다/-습니다 form for verbs): ① 저는 병원에서 ____. (일하다) ② 민수 씨는 제 ____입니다. 우리는 같은 팀에서 일합니다.
Answer in Korean, using the dialogue: ① 마크 씨는 한국어를 어디에서 배웠습니까? ② 수진 씨는 점심을 보통 어디에서 먹습니까?
answers: ① 사무실이 넓습니까? ② 지금 바쁩니까? ③ 매일 운동합니까?
① 대학교에서 배웠습니다. ② 회사 식당에서 먹습니다.
